review_scope: All 18 public repositories: declared dependency files, installation controls, consistency checks, sealed-release boundaries, and no-third-party-runtime claims.

policy.upgrade_rule: Adopt only source-backed compatible updates that pass the repository's native install, consistency, compilation, test, and release gates.
policy.major_version_rule: Major-version changes require a dedicated compatibility and release review and are never applied silently.
policy.lock_rule: Hash-locked and checksum-sealed releases remain unchanged unless the complete lock, manifest, SBOM, tests, and checksums are regenerated and verified together.
policy.conflict_rule: When authoritative upstream listings conflict, retain the verified hash-locked artifact and record the conflict for a later review.

status_definitions.no_third_party_runtime: The public project uses the language runtime or operating-system facilities without an application dependency install.
status_definitions.exact_pins: Direct dependencies are fixed to reviewed versions and CI validates the resolved environment.
status_definitions.hash_locked: The complete runtime set is pinned to exact artifacts with SHA-256 hashes.
status_definitions.bounded_ranges: The application accepts a reviewed major-version range and CI resolves and checks the resulting environment.
status_definitions.sealed_audited_release: Dependency files are part of a checksum-controlled release and include an explicit vulnerability-audit gate.
